title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer Game Launches on November 10
content: Kyoto-based indie studio Denkiworks announced during Nintendo 's Indie World Showcase on Wednesday that its TANUKI: Pon's Summer game will launch for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC via Steam on November 10.

title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center, Schrödinger's Call Games Get Switch 2 Releases
content: Shueisha Games announced during Nintendo 's Japanese Indie World 2026 livestream on Wednesday that the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and Schrödinger's Call games have both launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on the same day. An upgrade pack from the respective Nintendo Switch version is available for each game.
